answer.explanation: Within the window, CrudApiFunction logged 262 AccessDeniedException errors on dynamodb:PutItem against CartTable (lambda-rca-bench-CartTable-16124ULMPVK4O). The live inline policy app-policy on CrudApiRole only allows dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query, while the committed template grants dynamodb:PutItem, GetItem and Query on the same table. The role has drifted from the intended state, so the execution-role permission is missing. Other functions showed no errors in the window. The Compression function had a NoSuchBucket failure at 11:21, before the window, and its live config now matches the template, so it is not the cause here.
